protocol_notes: The charging calibration database now stores every recent PhoneArena smartphone row, including partially tested devices; the v0.6.0 estimator activates only references with wired charger power, measured full-charge time and measured 30-minute progress.
Primary comparable observations use PhoneArena's wired charging benchmark. Selected flagship records preserve GSMArena and Tom's Guide secondary observations for cross-lab validation.
Reference values are observations. Advertised charger wattage is never treated as sustained battery input power.
notes: Charging database contains 119 recent released phones; incomplete lab rows remain stored but are excluded from active curve fitting.
Supplemental GSMArena lab records expand the charging database to 140 recent phones and add Realme, Tecno, Infinix and iQOO coverage.
